content:
LeanExplore v1.0.0 is out!

  • :moon: Nightly database updates. Keeping AI agents and humans alike up to date
  • :books: New repositories indexed. CSLib, FLT, and Formal Conjectures
  • :search: Much improved informal search. A reranker model helps significantly with both natural language and symbolic queries
  • :snake: Simplified Python API. Easy to integrate into your tooling
  • :puzzle_piece: Easily expandable. Wraps doc-gen4, so adding new repositories is straightforward

https://leanexplore.com | PyPI | GitHub

Please leave any feedback or ideas in the update discussion thread.
